<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex012012026-06-2212-38-01" status="unreviewed">de nyid ci'i phyir na 'di'i brjod bya mkhyen pa gsum theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa so so'i <lb edRef="inst:4547" n="17a7"/> rgyud dang 'brel pa'i phyir ro | rgyud dang 'brel ba'i phyir ro||
<note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> mkhyen gsum rjes mthun skye ba [MSb_x]rtogs tsam pa la 'dod do ||
|<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3816">ar</rs> gyis skyon bkod pa'i sbyor ba 'ang rjes mthun du 'gyur ro ||
yang na so skye'i sa na mkhyen gsum mtshan nyid par 'gyur ro zer ro||
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3816">ar</rs> mtshon byed kyi chos sum bcur 'dod de|_de mchod brjod yul du 'ang ma bzhag pas mi 'thad do|| </note></seg></TEI>
